class.name: ChorusLoadPhase
class.brief_description: Phase of an accepted model load.
class.description: Phase reported by [signal GodotChorus.model_load_progress]. A fraction, when available, describes only that phase, not total time. Even a fraction of [code]1.0[/code] does not mean the engine is ready; wait for [signal GodotChorus.model_loaded].

constants.constant: Waiting for previous work to stop and releasing the old engine. No fractional progress is reported.
Loading provider assets such as model weights. A fraction may be available.
Preparing the engine after loading its assets. No fractional progress is currently reported.
